workflow: An owned isolated AutoCAD 24.3 desktop process runs native -LAYOUT New, Copy and Delete, reorders by TabOrder, checks copied viewport and paper-entity identity, saves an anonymous temporary native DWG, reopens it, then proves final-paper and 255-paper limits before the owned process is terminated.
result: AutoCAD created and removed F097 CREATED, inserted F097 PLAN (2) before its source, copied a paper-space circle, viewport and plot rotation with fresh native handles, kept the copy independent after source editing, activated adjacent PLAN after delete, rejected duplicate-case, invalid-character and 256-character names, preserved the last paper layout as a no-op, rejected paper layout 256, and preserved the final tabs after DWG reopen.
